goal_template: Complete <GOAL> in one call with no follow-up needed.
opening_intent: States the reason for calling in one plain sentence, then waits for the agent to lead.
followup_intents: answers exactly what was asked, nothing extra
asks one clarifying question if an instruction is ambiguous
confirms details the agent reads back
asks what happens next before ending
success_criteria: the stated goal is completed or a concrete next step is promised
every detail the caller provided was confirmed back correctly
